description: Apex G, a dedicated two-person research team competing in NASA Space Apps Challenge. Our focus is on rigorous scientific research, comparative planetary geology, and building a high-impact research paper evaluating terrestrial analogs for lunar and Martian exploration. We bring strong skills in data analysis, scientific writing, and geospatial evaluation. We are looking for a collaborative spirit who shares our ambition to produce top-tier academic-style research under a hackathon timeline.
